Cabin Pressure.alert_condition_description: Alert when cabin pressure is below 10.9 PSI or above 14.7 PSI.

Autopilot Status.alert_condition_description: Alert when autopilot_status does not match the expected value for the flight's simple_status. Cruise must be ON. Parked, Taxiing, and Takeoff/Landing must be OFF.

WiFi Usage.alert_condition_description: Alert when WiFi Usage is 0 during Cruise, or when WiFi Usage is greater than 0 while Parked.
